title: 39c vs 11c
subtitle: Household electricity price per kWh, early 2026

lines.say: A household in Ireland pays 39 cents for every kilowatt-hour of electricity.
In Hungary: 11 cents. Same electricity, more than three times the price.
For a home that uses 3,500 kilowatt-hours a year, that's about 1,355 euros in Ireland, and about 400 in Hungary.
Hungary's prices are set by the state. In Ireland, the energy itself is expensive, because much of it is made from gas.
Where does your country sit? All of Europe is in our full video.
